candidate_sentence_map.S1: During the twelve-month financial year ended June 30, 2025, SAF Tehnika reported an unaudited consolidated net turnover of EUR 26.11 million, representing a 4% decline compared with EUR 27.09 million in the previous financial year.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: Despite the decrease in revenue, the company significantly reduced its bottom-line losses.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: The Group closed the reporting period with a net loss of EUR 820 thousand, which is an improvement compared with the net loss of EUR 2.37 million recorded for the 2023/2024 financial year.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: Basic earnings per share improved to negative EUR 0.28 from negative EUR 0.80 in the prior year.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: For the fourth quarter of the 2024/2025 financial year, net turnover reached EUR 5.18 million, marking a 13% decrease compared with the corresponding period of the previous year.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: The fourth-quarter net loss widened to EUR 913 thousand from a loss of EUR 498 thousand in the fourth quarter of the preceding financial year.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: Management noted that quarterly turnover fluctuations are frequently influenced by the completion timing, scope, and complexity of individual projects, along with production durations and material procurement lead times.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: Geographically, performance varied across regions during the twelve-month period.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: Revenues in the North and Latin America region declined by 14% to EUR 14.28 million, accounting for 55% of total turnover.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: Conversely, European revenues increased by 17% to EUR 10.04 million, representing 38% of total sales.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: The Asia, Africa, and Middle East region generated EUR 1.78 million, reflecting a 5% decrease and comprising 7% of total revenue.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: Throughout the period, the Group continued to invest in new product development, product enhancements, and sales promotion across existing and new market segments.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: Operations were previously impacted by global shortages of electronic components, prompting the company to accumulate material reserves to ensure competitive delivery times, a strategy that has helped delivery timelines improve recently.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: Total assets increased to EUR 25.92 million as of June 30, 2025, compared with EUR 23.02 million at the end of the previous financial year.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: Total owners equity stood at EUR 15.58 million at the end of the period.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: The Group maintained a strong liquidity position, generating a net cash flow of EUR 2.6 million over the twelve-month period and closing the year with a cash and bank balance of EUR 4.8 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: Customer prepayments for goods and services reached EUR 3.9 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: To further support liquidity, the parent company maintained an active, unutilized credit line agreement with Luminor Bank AS for EUR 4.95 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S19: Total headcount rose slightly to 273 employees at the end of the reporting period, compared with 265 employees at the close of the prior financial year.
candidate_sentence_map.S20: Management remains cautious regarding specific forecasts while actively focusing on product diversification and stabilizing turnover to achieve long-term profitability.
